name: Vida
description: Small cream EB Garamond italic for most of the video, with the hook and the key lines set whole as a film poster: a line of Garamond italic and one word in huge Anton uppercase, the caption's last or else its first, each word appearing as it is said. Where the person stays steady in the shot, a poster that ends on its big word rises to the top of the frame and passes behind them, like a magazine masthead; elsewhere it sits in the lower half. Cinematic look.
